He is also an important character in some of the major storylines . Originally he stopped at the Dentons ' to stay the night before embarking on a hiking trip with a friend . However , his friend was murdered by Tubbs and Edward . Tubbs now permanently wears the friend 's walking boots .

List of The League of Gentlemen characters
Briss , played by Gatiss , is a butcher and proprietor of Hilary Briss and Son , Royston Vasey 's local butchers . His wares include a secret `` special stuff '' ; a mysterious and highly addictive foodstuff , which , it is implied , is both illegal and hideously immoral . Many authority figures are `` in '' on Briss ' activities , including Police Inspector Cox , Magistrate Maurice Evans ( Pemberton ) and Councillor Samuel Chignell ( Shearsmith ) , all of whom become hopelessly addicted .
